Usage

Feed concentrate and water quality is the most
important factor affecting fish health and
performance in Aquaculture. Different fish species
have different and specific range of water quality
aspects (temperature, pH, oxygen concentration,
salinity, hardness, etc.) within which they can
survive, grow and reproduce. It is therefore very
important to ensure that the physical and chemical
conditions of the water remain within the optimum
range of the fish under culture at all times. Other
critical factors affecting fish health and yield are
nutritionally poor fish feed supplements and lack of
pond maintenance.

nutritionally rich fish farming! Netsurf Network
